# Chapter 1: Introduction

This is page 1 introduction to mechanistic interpretability.
We explore internal representations of deep learning models.
Models pack multiple features in low-dimensional spaces.

## Probing Representations

Linear probes can measure the presence of specific concepts in activations.
If a linear classifier achieves high accuracy, the concept is linearly represented.

## Future Directions

Scaling dictionary learning to frontier models remains a challenging research frontier.
Sparse autoencoders offer a promising path forward.
